tasks.title: Implement retryWithBackoff for flaky tests
tasks.input: Create src/retry.mjs exporting retryWithBackoff for flaky tests. Verify the retry and backoff contract.

hiddenFiles..eval-hidden/retry.test.mjs: import test from 'node:test'; import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { retryWithBackoff } from '../src/retry.mjs'; test('retries', async () => { let n=0; const started=Date.now(); const value=await retryWithBackoff(async()=>{ n+=1; if(n<3) throw new Error('flaky'); return 'ok'; }, {attempts:3, delayMs:10}); assert.equal(value,'ok'); assert.equal(n,3); assert.ok(Date.now()-started>=20); });
